areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Specific objectives and two components on urban requalification and housing in vulnerable areas; relevant indicators; relevant resources with high potential impact.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Specific objective, large sports and leisure facilities and coastal sports spaces, an indicator with target for monthly users; resource share considered; low impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Specific objectives, housing improvement target, nature-based drainage and recovery works; resources shared with other areas so not exclusive; impact present but more targeted actions needed.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Training and consulting for informal tourism workers with indicators and targets for vulnerable groups; low impact given limited target audience relative to the local population and modest resources.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Professional training plus tourist-oriented urban facilities strengthen attractiveness; resources are shared with other areas and cannot count fully; low impact.

areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: No exclusive, relevant actions for local arts and culture; no specific indicators, targets or objectives.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Works in historically excluded territories, but no effective indicators measuring social inclusion; actions fit better in other areas.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: No exclusive actions for women's protection and no consistent indicators, targets or objectives.

areas.name: Anti-racism
areas.reason: Benefits territories with many Black residents, but no specific objectives or robust indicators on combating racism.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: Lighting and public-space occupation only indirectly promote safety; no specific objectives or indicators, so efficiency and impact cannot be assessed.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Native-vegetation recovery and a coastal park planned, but no indicators specific to this area, so targets and impact cannot be measured.

areas.name: Competitiveness

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Actions reduce territorial gaps within the municipality only, so they do not fit this area.
